name: gh_list_repos
description: List all your repositories including private ones. Returns repo names, URLs, descriptions, language, stars, and last update time.

sort.description: Sort by: created, updated, pushed, full_name

name: gh_get_repo
description: Get detailed info for a specific repository. Returns description, language, stars, forks, open issues, default branch, and access level.

name: gh_list_issues
description: List issues in a repository. Specify owner and repo name (e.g., owner='octocat', repo='Hello-World'). Returns titles, numbers, status, assignees, and labels.

name: gh_list_pulls
description: List pull requests in a repository. Specify owner and repo name (e.g., owner='octocat', repo='Hello-World'). Returns titles, numbers, status, reviewers, and merge state.

name: gh_list_orgs
description: List organizations you're a member of. Returns org names, URLs, and your role (owner, member, etc.).

name: gh_get_file
description: Get file contents from a repository. Specify owner, repo name, and file path (e.g., 'README.md'). Returns raw content and metadata.

ref.description: Branch or commit SHA (default: default branch)
